item.title: elizaOS Intelligence: 2026-07-08
item.description:
Summary: elizaOS is undergoing major architectural and structural shifts, including a migration away from the Ai16z platform and the dissolution of the Labs entity. Development remains active with significant focus on security hardening, monetization rails, and production-grade cloud infrastructure.

GitHub Activity:

  • release: promote develop → production (money-integrity wave, monetization rails, auth overhaul, live rate limiting) (merged)
  • Promote develop → main (367 commits, 2026-07-04 demo wave) (merged)
  • feat(ui): launcher curation — apps/developer pages + wallet sub-views (closed)

Community Highlights:

  • #discussion: Community discussed the strategy behind migrating away from the Ai16z platform and the transition to a foundation-led model after the dissolution of Labs....
